definitions: A bag of cloth, leather, or plastic filled with soft material, used for sitting or kneeling on or for resting one's head on.
Something providing protection against impact or an unpleasant situation.
The padded rim around a billiard table or snooker table.
examples: She sank back into the cushions.
The extra money will provide a cushion against unexpected expenses.
The ball bounced off the cushion.
